ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate the central 75-80% of the visible fluke area, with low-intensity black pixels localized to the trailing edges, distal tips, and proximal peduncle region.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the medial portions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous border along the trailing edge and distal tips. Isolated, low-intensity circular and irregular pixel clusters (spots) are distributed across the high-intensity white surface, primarily on the left lobe and lower right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 55 degrees and significant depth relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern characterized by jagged peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge, isolated from the background water pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer lateral boundaries exhibit a convex curve trajectory leading to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups are concentrated at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized barnacle attachments.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (scratches) are visible across the high-intensity white regions of both lobes, including prominent diagonal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue loss and jaggedness along the trailing edge boundary; multiple linear rake marks across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy barnacle colonization localized specifically on the dorsal/ventral tips of the fluke lobes.
